newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas mostly lower on milder weather.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas mostly lower on milder weather.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were mostly lower Tuesday due to milder temperatures across most of the U.S. and Canada, market sources said.
At the AECO storage hub, prices for Wednesday delivery eased by about eight cents to the C$2.23-2.28 per gigajoule (GJ) range.
Temperatures in Calgary hovered around -7 degrees Celsius and were expected to reach +4 degrees C by the weekend, sources said.
As a result of the faltering day market, March AECO prices were also talked lower in the C$2.06-2.07 per GJ area.
At Sumas, Wash., swing prices gained about five cents to the $1.90-1.95 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) range, as fears waned over Northwest Pipeline's explosions this past weekend.
The pipeline company said repairs would likely be complete in a few days.
At Niagara, prices fell by about 10 cents to the low-to-mid $2.60s per mmBtu, as temperatures moderated in the East.
